Definition: akin to G5335; to malign, i.e. (by extension) to fascinate (by false representations):--bewitch.
BiblicalUsage: Baskaino means to bewitch, to fascinate with false words, and Paul asks the Galatians who has bewitched them that they should not obey the truth, when Christ was plainly set forth crucified before their eyes.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that bewitching is what false teaching does when it looks spiritual, and Paul's question is still the right one for anyone who has drifted from the plain gospel.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
